requests.description:
Find administrative divisions, filtering by optional criteria. If no criteria are set, you will get back all
known divisions.
requests.name: Find administrative divisions
requests.note: Replace {{GEODB_CITIES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description:
Get the details for a specific administrative division, including location coordinates, population, and
elevation above sea-level (if available).
requests.name: Get administrative division details
requests.note: Replace {{GEODB_CITIES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
